title: Daily GitHub Actions Cron for Brain Memory Validate, Pack-Snapshot, and Google Drive Push-Snapshot
public_summary: Add deterministic pending-snapshot planning in brain_memory.py and a scheduled/dispatchable GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/brain-memory-cron.yml) that validates workflows/memory/*.jsonl, packs changed/unsynced daily snapshots, and pushes archives + manifest sidecars to Google Drive Vault safely under PR-only main rulesets.
inputs: Owner instruction: connect daily GitHub Actions Cron to run validate -> pack-snapshot -> push-snapshot to Google Drive automatically
Existing Daily Brain Memory storage & CLI (python/alpha_mining/storage/brain_memory.py, scripts/brain_memory.py, python/alpha_mining/storage/vault.py)
PR-only 2-layer GitHub Rulesets on main with zero bypass actors and static safety invariants in python/tests/test_github_workflows.py
outputs: .github/workflows/brain-memory-cron.yml (schedule 18:00 UTC daily + workflow_dispatch with session_date, dry_run, force_resync)
Updated workflows/memory/README.md and regression tests in python/tests/test_brain_memory.py and python/tests/test_github_workflows.py
constraints: Never reference secrets.* in any GitHub Actions if: expression
Require include-hidden-files: true on actions/upload-artifact whenever path contains a dot-prefixed segment
Install rclone (and zstd) before any --backend rclone execution in Ubuntu runner jobs
Never attempt direct push to main; persist state across runs via Actions Cache, workflow artifacts, and Drive state_snapshots/manifests/ sidecar

Compare canonical serialized JSONL SHA-256 against manifest files + verify valid last_pushed_utc so minor trailing blank lines do not trigger duplicate uploads and failed/skipped pushes never falsely mark synced
Preserve all existing tests and governance charters (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, roles/) untouched
assumptions: RCLONE_CONFIG_GDRIVE Secret is not yet configured in repository Secrets (verified via gh secret list), so live remote Drive upload requires Owner adding the Secret after PR merge while dry-run and unit tests verify workflow logic cleanly
acceptance_criteria: alpha-ovca validate-brief and verify-stream pass on workflows/runs/wf-brain-memory-cron-001/
scripts/brain_memory.py validate and plan-sync pass on workflows/memory/ and detect missing/changed/never-pushed snapshots vs already-pushed snapshots
test_github_workflows.py passes on .github/workflows/brain-memory-cron.yml including rclone install ordering, no secrets-in-if, and hidden artifact upload flags
Full Python unittest suite, Rust cargo fmt/check/test/clippy --locked, github_ruleset validate-configs, and admission_gate parity pass cleanly

authority.objective: Wire automated daily GitHub Actions Brain Memory validate -> pack-snapshot -> push-snapshot cron cleanly on a dedicated feature branch
constraints: Keep PR bounded to approved scope; do not bypass Rulesets or alter governance files
